title: Opportunities for engineering students
description: Internships, research, scholarships, events and jobs listed on the opportunities tab. Array order is the default display order.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema so editors like VS Code offer autocomplete, e.g. "../schemas/opportunities.schema.json".

date.description: A calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2027-02-15".

id.description: Stable unique lowercase slug, e.g. "urap-spring-2027". Letters, digits and single hyphens only.

title.description: Short headline, e.g. "Undergraduate Research Apprentice Program (URAP)".

organization.description: Who is offering it, e.g. "UC Berkeley Office of Undergraduate Research".

url.description: Full https link where students learn more or apply.

description.description: Plain-text summary (no HTML), a few sentences at most.

deadline.description: Last day to apply or register, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for rolling or no-deadline opportunities.

eventDate.description: For events: the day it happens, as YYYY-MM-DD.

postedDate.description: Day this entry was added, as YYYY-MM-DD. Used to show "new" badges and sort by recency.

location.description: Where it happens, e.g. "Remote", "Berkeley, CA" or "MLK Jr. Student Union, Pauley Ballroom".

eligibility.description: Who can apply, in plain words, e.g. "Undergraduates in any major; no prior research experience needed."

paid.description: true if the position is paid or the award includes money, false if unpaid. Leave out if unknown or not applicable.

contact.description: Optional person or mailbox to ask questions.

name.description: Contact name or team, e.g. "ESC Technical Committee".
